evidence.dominant_driver: Japan fiscal credibility: tax cut to be funded without deficit-covering bonds

absorption.reason: Nikkei was already up roughly 0.4-0.8% in the morning while USD/JPY strengthened, so the fiscal headline did not trigger a clean new equity impulse.

observed_reaction.NI225: about +0.4% to +0.8% on session; attribution mixed

evidence.decision_notes: Residual move only; global rates/oil dominate more than this fiscal comment.

regimes.global: higher yields + expensive oil; cautious risk tone

immediate.rationale: Headline is fiscally constructive but largely absorbed and global yield/oil pressure conflicts.

next_session.rationale: Fiscal credibility helps at margin, but BOJ/Fed and global yields dominate next session.

15m.rationale: No clean residual catalyst after partial absorption.

1h.rationale: Constructive fiscal signal offset by high global yields and weaker yen dynamics.

4h.rationale: If fiscal-risk premium eases, equities can retain a modest support bias.

next_session.rationale: BOJ/Fed event risk dominates the fiscal comment.

predictions.counter_case: If JGB yields rise despite the funding pledge or BOJ hike expectations intensify, NI225 could reverse lower.
